verdicts.title: The automorphism group of the bipartite Kneser graph
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Let $n$ and $k$ be integers with $n>2k, k\geq1$. We denote by $H(n, k)$ the $bipartite\ Kneser\ graph$, that is, a graph with the family of $k$-subsets and ($n-k$)-subsets of $[n] = \{1, 2, ... , n\}$ as vertices, in which

verdicts.title: The automorphism group of the $s$-stable Kneser graphs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For $k,s\geq2$, the $s$-stable Kneser graphs are the graphs with vertex set the $k$-subsets $S$ of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ such that the circular distance between any two elements in $S$ is at least $s$ and two vertices are adjacent if and only if the corresponding $k$-subset are disjoint. verdicts.title: Graphs whose Kronecker covers are bipartite Kneser graphs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that there are $k$ simple graphs whose Kronecker covers are isomorphic to the bipartite Kneser graph $H(n,k)$, and that their chromatic numbers coincide with $χ(K(n,k)) = n - 2k + 2$. We also determine the automorphism groups of these graphs.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Kronecker covers of bipartite Kneser graphs H(n,k), their chromatic numbers, and automorphism groups — it does not address CNF formulas, SAT satisfying assignments, or any O(n^2 log n) automorphism bound for SAT-associated Kneser graphs.
